Claustrum and target ROI volumes in preterm- and full-term-born neonates (dHCP cohort; Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 2). Mean ± SD and range per group; groups compared with two-sample t-tests, uncorrected.

- Input: `data/dHCP_CP_control_volumes_distance.csv` (claustrum volume in structural space, seed volume and voxels and target volumes in diffusion space, demographics)
- Outputs (`outputs/tables`):
  - `Revision_volumes_seed_FTvsPT_dHCP_<date>.csv`: claustrum volumes (results/volumes_seed_dHCP.csv)
  - `Revision_volumes_target_FTvsPT_dHCP_<date>.csv`: target volumes (results/volumes_target_dHCP.csv)

# 1 Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

#### Lookup tables for variable names

```{r}
roi_labels <- c(
  l_claustrum_ac_occ_l  = "Occipital Associative (L)",
  r_claustrum_ac_occ_r  = "Occipital Associative (R)",
  l_claustrum_ac_par_l  = "Parietal Associative (L)",
  r_claustrum_ac_par_r  = "Parietal Associative (R)",
  l_claustrum_ac_pfc_l  = "Prefrontal Associative (L)",
  r_claustrum_ac_pfc_r  = "Prefrontal Associative (R)",
  l_claustrum_ac_temp_l = "Temporal Associative (L)",
  r_claustrum_ac_temp_r = "Temporal Associative (R)",
  l_claustrum_c_pos_l   = "Posterior Cingulate (L)",
  r_claustrum_c_pos_r   = "Posterior Cingulate (R)",
  l_claustrum_c_ant_l   = "Anterior Cingulate (L)",
  r_claustrum_c_ant_r   = "Anterior Cingulate (R)",
  l_claustrum_pc_aud_l  = "Primary Auditory (L)",
  r_claustrum_pc_aud_r  = "Primary Auditory (R)",
  l_claustrum_pc_mot_l  = "Primary Motor (L)",
  r_claustrum_pc_mot_r  = "Primary Motor (R)",
  l_claustrum_pc_sens_l = "Primary Somatosensory (L)",
```

### Load data

```{r}
dat <- read_delim(
  here::here("data", "dHCP_CP_control_volumes_distance.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", "."),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject_ID = col_character(),
    Session_ID = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      group == "term" ~ "FT",
      group == "pre"  ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

# --- check data loaded ---
stopifnot(nrow(dat) == 144, !anyNA(dat$group), !anyNA(dat$sex))
```

# 2 Table summary of seed and target volumes

```{r}
summ_vol_one <- function(var, label, digits = 0){
  d <- dat |>
    dplyr::select(group, dplyr::all_of(var)) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  x <- d[[var]][d$group == "FT"]
  y <- d[[var]][d$group == "PT"]

  use_welch <- var.test(x, y)$p.value < 0.05
  tt <- t.test(x, y, var.equal = !use_welch)

  ms <- function(z) {
    paste0(
      formatC(mean(z), format = "f", digits = digits),
      " ± ",
      formatC(sd(z), format = "f", digits = digits)
    )
  }

  rng <- function(z) {
    paste0(
      "[",
      formatC(min(z), format = "f", digits = digits),
      "–",
      formatC(max(z), format = "f", digits = digits),
      "]"
    )
  }

  df_txt <- if (use_welch) {
    sprintf("%.1f", unname(tt$parameter))
  } else {
    sprintf("%d", as.integer(round(unname(tt$parameter))))
  }

  tibble(
    Variable = label,
    n_FT = length(x),
    FT = ms(x),
    range_FT = rng(x),
    n_PT = length(y),
    PT = ms(y),
    range_PT = rng(y),
    mean_diff = mean(x) - mean(y),   # positive = larger in FT
    t_df = sprintf(
      "%.2f(%s)%s",
      unname(tt$statistic),
      df_txt,
      if (use_welch) "*" else ""
    ),
    p = tt$p.value
  )
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
}

# Claustrum seed voxels/volumes
seed_spec <- tibble::tribble(
  ~var,           ~label,                                             ~digits,
  "struct_vol_l", "Claustrum volume, structural space, L (mm³)",       0,
  "struct_vol_r", "Claustrum volume, structural space, R (mm³)",       0,
  "seed_vol_l",   "Claustrum seed volume, diffusion space, L (mm³)",   0,
  "seed_vol_r",   "Claustrum seed volume, diffusion space, R (mm³)",   0,
  "seed_vox_l",   "Claustrum seed voxels, diffusion space, L",         0,
  "seed_vox_r",   "Claustrum seed voxels, diffusion space, R",         0
)

stopifnot(all(sapply(dat[seed_spec$var], is.numeric)))

res_seed <- purrr::pmap_dfr(seed_spec, summ_vol_one)

# Target volumes
target_vars <- grep("^target_vol_", names(dat), value = TRUE)

target_key <- function(v) {
  r <- sub("^target_vol_", "", v)
  paste0(substring(r, nchar(r)), "_claustrum_", r)
}

stopifnot(
  length(target_vars) == 22,
  all(sapply(dat[target_vars], is.numeric)),
  setequal(target_key(target_vars), names(roi_labels))
)

target_spec <- tibble(var = target_vars) |>
  mutate(
    label  = unname(roi_labels[target_key(var)]),
    digits = 0
  ) |>
  arrange(match(target_key(var), names(roi_labels)))

res_target <- purrr::pmap_dfr(target_spec, summ_vol_one)

# Format as tables
tab_seed <- res_seed |>
  transmute(
    Variable,
    `FT mean ± SD [range]` = paste(FT, range_FT),
    `PT mean ± SD [range]` = paste(PT, range_PT),
    `Mean difference (FT − PT)` = round(mean_diff, 0),
    `t(df)` = t_df,
    P = fmt_p(p)
  )

tab_target <- res_target |>
  transmute(
    Variable,
    `FT mean ± SD [range]` = paste(FT, range_FT),
    `PT mean ± SD [range]` = paste(PT, range_PT),
    `Mean difference (FT − PT)` = round(mean_diff, 0),
    `t(df)` = t_df,
    P = fmt_p(p)
  )

# save outputs
readr::write_excel_csv2(
  tab_seed,
  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_volumes_seed_FTvsPT_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"))
)

readr::write_excel_csv2(
  tab_target,
  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_volumes_target_FTvsPT_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"))
)
```
